name: State Merit Scholarship with Conflicting Income and Stale Cycle
question: What are the eligibility requirements, family income limit, and deadline for the State Merit Scholarship?

sources.title: Official State Scholarships Portal - 2026 Notification
sources.cleanedText: Government of Karnataka State Merit Scholarship Notification for Academic Year AY 2026-27. Last date of application is 15 March 2026. The annual family income ceiling is fixed at Rs 6,00,000 per annum for all categories. Mandatory documents include Income Certificate and previous academic marks cards. Application portal is at https://scholarships.state.gov.in.

sources.title: State Scholarship Eligibility & Last Date - Education Updates
sources.cleanedText: Guidance for State Merit Scholarship Scheme for session 2024-25. The deadline to submit the online form is 30 August 2024. Please note that the maximum family income limit is Rs 2,50,000 per year. Candidates must provide caste certificate and income certificate.
